verses.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le malaia e oo r perofeta pepelo > Oi talofa i le au leoleo mamoe O e ua fano ai ma faataapeapeina mamoe na ou fagaina! o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu i le au leoleo mamoe o e leoleo i lo‘u nuu, Ua outou faataapeapeina la‘u lafu mamoe, ma tulia i latou, ma ua le asiasi ia te i latou; faauta, ou te taui atu ia te outou ona o le leaga o a outou amioga, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.sm: Ou te faapotopoto foi i e totoe o laʻu lafu mamoe mai nuu uma na ou tulia ai i latou, ma ou toe faafoi mai ia te i latou i o latou lotoā; latou te fanafanau ai ma uluola ai.

verses.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ou te tofia foi mo i latou o leoleo mamoe e leoleo ia te i latou; latou te le toe fefefe, latou te le matatau foi, e leai so latou e le iloa o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.sm: Faauta, e 00 mai ona aso, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII, ou te faatupuina ai mo Tavita le La laau amiotonu, e pule foi le Tupu, e manuia o ia, e faia foi e ia le faamasinoga ma le amiotonu i le lalolagi.

verses.en: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
verses.sm: O lana nofoaiga e faaolaina ai Iuta, e nofo foi Isaraelu ma le filemu; o le suafa foi lenei outou tusia lenei tagata e aufanaua, e taʻua ai o ia, O LE ALII LA TATOU AMIOTONU.

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, o loo fetalai mai ai le Atu, e oo mai ona po e le toe fai ane ai tagata, O loo soifua le AL11, o le na aveina ae le fanauga a Isaraelu nai le nuu o Aikupito;

verses.en: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.sm: a e faapea, O loo soifua le Atu, o le na aveina ae, ma le na aumaiz. le fanau a le aiga o Isaraelu mai le nuu i le itu i matu, ta nuu uma na aʻu tulia ai i latou; e nonořo foi i latou i lo latou laueleele.

verses.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.sm: Ua momonio loʻu loto i totonu ia te au ona o perofeta; ua gatete oʻu ivi uma; ua avea aʻu e pei o le tagata ona, e pei o le tagata ua faiaina i le uaina, ona o le ALII ma ana afioga paia.

verses.en: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.sm: Aua ua tumu le nuu i e mulilulua; aua ua faanoanoa le nuu ona ua faafanoina; ua magumagu mea i le vao e tataa ai manu, aua ua leaga lo latou taufetuliga, ua le tonu foi lo latou malosi.

verses.en: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua o perofeta atoa ma faitaulaga ua faalematau i latou; ua iloa e afu la latou amio leaga i loʻu lava fale, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALu.

verses.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e avea ai lo latou ala ia te i latou e pei o mea maseesee i le pouliuli; e tulia i latou, ma latou pauu i ai; aua ou te faaooina le malaia i luga ia te i latou, o le tausaga lea e asiasia mai ai i latou, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALI.

verses.en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.sm: Ua ou iloa le faavalea o perofeta o Samaria; ua latou vavalo ile igoa o Paala, ma faaseseina loʻu nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.sm: Ua ou iloa foi le mea e inosia i perofeta o Ierusalema; ua latou mulilulua, ma savavali ma le pepelo; ua faamalolosia foi e i latou lima o e amio leaga, ina ia le toe foi mai se tasi ai lana amio leaga; ua avea i latou uma ia te au e pei o Sotoma, ma e o nonofo ai e pei o Komoro.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALıı o “au i perofeta, Faauta, ou te fafaga ia te i latou i le laena, ma faainu ia te i latou i vai oona; aua o perofeta o Ierusalema ua oo atu ai le amio faalematau i le nuu uma.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, Aua tou te faalogologo i upu a perofeta o e vavalo ia te outou; ua latou faasese ia te outou e fai mea faatauvaa; ua latou tautala atu i le faaaliga mai o latou lava loto, a e le mai le fofoga o le ALI.

verses.en: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.sm: O loo tautala atu pea i latou i e “ino'ino mai ia te au, O loo fetalai mai le AL11, E manuia outou; ma ua latou faapea atu ia te i latou uma o e savavali e tusa ma le finau vale o latou loto, E le co ia te outou se malaia.

verses.en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
verses.sm: A o ai ea ua tu atu a O fai le pule a le AL11, ma ua iloa ma faalogologo i lana afioga? Po o ai ua uai atu ona taliga i ana afioga, ma faalogologo i ai?

verses.en: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua alu atu le afa mai le ALII i le toasa, o le afā fulifaò; e pesi tetele mai i luga o ulu o e amio leaga.

verses.en: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.sm: E le toe liliu le toasa o le AL, seia faia e ia, seia faataunuuina foi e ja manatu o lona finagalo; tou te matuā mafaufau i ai i aso amuli.

verses.en: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.sm: Ua ou le aauina atu o ia perofeta, a ua latou taufetuli; ua ou le tautala atu ia te i latou, a ua latou vavalo.

verses.en: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.sm: A e afai ana latou I096 tutu mai a o fai lau pule, po ua latou faailoa atu au upu i loʻu nuu, ma latou faafoi ia te i latou ai o latou ala leaga, ma le leaga o a latou amioga.

verses.en: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
verses.sm: O aʻu ea o le Atua e latalata, a e le o le Atua e mamao? o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Pe mafai ea e se tagata ona 1au i mea lilo, ou te le iloa ai o ia? o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII. E le o tutumu ea le lagi ma le lalolagi ia te au? o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.sm: Ua ou faalogo i mea ua fai atu ai perofeta, o e ua vavalo ma le pepelo i loʻu igoa, ua faapea atu, Ua fai la‘u miti, ua fai lau miti.

verses.en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.sm: E i ai lenei mea seia afea i loto o perofeta, o e vavalo mai ma le pepelo, o perofeta lava i latou o le pepelo ua i o latou loto?

verses.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.sm: o loo manatu i latou ia faagaloina e lo‘u nuu o loʻu igoa i a latou miti, ua latou talatala atu ai o le tasi i le tasi, e pei ona faagalogalo e o latou tama o loʻu igoa ona o Paala.

verses.en: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le perofeta ua na fai le miti, ia talatala atu lana miti; ma le ua ia te ia lau upu, ia talatala atu e ia laʻu upu ma le faamaoni. E tusa ea le ‘au o saito i le fua o le saito? o loo fetalai mai ai le ALI.

verses.en: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.sm: E le pei o le afi ea la‘u upu? o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII; e le pei o le samala foi e tu‘imomoia ai le papa?

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, e fai ai mo'u fili o perofeta, o e o fegaoiai au upu, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai mai le ALII, Faauta, e fai mo'u fili o perofeta, o e tautala i o latou laulaufaiva, ua faapea atu, Ua fetalai mai o ia.

verses.en: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Faauta, e fai moʻu fili i latou o e vavalo i miti pepelo, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII, ma latou talatala atu ai, ma faaseseina ai loʻu nuu i a latou upu pepelo, ma lo latou mitamita vale; a o au na ou le aauina atu i latou, ma aʻu lei fai atu ia te i latou; o le mea lea e le aoga ai lava i latou i lenei nuu, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: A fesili mai foi ia te oe lenei nuu, po o le perofeta, po o le faitaulaga, e faapea mai, Se a ea le avega mai le ALII? Ona e tali atu ai lea ia te i latou, Se a se avega? Ou te lafoaiina outou, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.sm: A o le perofeta, po o le faitaulaga, po o le nuu, e fai mai, O le avega mai le ALII; ou te taui atu lava i lena tagata atoa ma lona aiga.

verses.en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.sm: Ia faapea ona outou tautala atu, o le tagata i lé la te tuaoi, ma le tagata i lona uso, Se a le tali mai le ALII? se a foi le afioga mai le ALII?

verses.en: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
verses.sm: Tou te le toe ta‘uta‘ua foi le avega mai le ALII; aua e taitasi le tagata ma fai lana lava upu ma avega ia te ia; aua ua faauigaeseina e outou afioga a le Atua soifua, o le ALII o “au, lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.sm: Ia faapea ona e fai atu i le perofeta, Se a le tali mai le ALII ia te oe? se a foi le afioga mai le ALII?

verses.en: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
verses.sm: A e afai tou te fai ane, O le avega mai le ALII; o le mea lea ua faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII, Aua ua outou fai ane lenei upu, O le avega mai le ALII, a ua ou avatu le feau ia te outou, ua faapea atu, Aua tou te fai ane, O le avega mai le ALII;

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, ou te matuá faagaloina ai outou, ma ou lafoaiina ai outou ai oʻu luma, atoa ma le aai na ou foaiina atu ia te outou ma o outou tama.

verses.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.sm: Ou te faaceina atu foi la te outou le luma e faavavau, ma le masiasi e faavavau, e le galo lava.
